id.description: Numeric id or 8-character `short_id` of a saved insight. Pass this or `query`, not both.

query.description: An insight query that is not saved yet, in the shape `insight-create` takes, for example `{ "kind": "InsightVizNode", "source": { "kind": "TrendsQuery", "series": [{ "kind": "EventsNode", "event": "$pageview" }], "dateRange": { "date_from": "-30d" } } }`. Pass this or `id`, not both.
